title: Make dialogs fully opaque and strengthen Product Editor workspace surface styling

requirements.text: Make the onboarding instructions modal fully opaque and easy to read by removing the forced `!bg-popover` styling from the dialog container and its header/body/footer, and using an opaque surface token (e.g., `bg-card`) with appropriate border/shadow so the modal is never translucent on any browser.

quotes: the popup window is still transparent and hard to read
Just say “yes, apply the fixes,” and I’ll update the code and redeploy so you can finally see the visual changes take effect.

acceptanceCriteria: When opening the onboarding instructions modal, the dialog surface is fully opaque (no translucency/see-through effect) in both light and dark themes.
The modal remains readable with clear contrast between background and text.
Scroll behavior and responsive sizing remain intact (modal content is still scrollable; no content is cut off on phone/tablet/desktop).
No `!bg-popover` overrides remain on the onboarding modal container/header/content/footer that could reintroduce transparency.

requirements.text: Make the Profile Setup dialog match the same opaque, readable dialog styling as the onboarding instructions modal by removing the forced `!bg-popover` styling and ensuring it uses an opaque surface background with consistent border/shadow treatment.

quotes: the popup window is still transparent and hard to read
Make all other app dialogs used in normal flows (at minimum the ProfileSetupDialog) match the same opaque, readable dialog styling as the Instructions modal

acceptanceCriteria: When the Profile Setup dialog is shown, the dialog surface is fully opaque (no translucency) in both light and dark themes.
The dialog content (title, description, input, buttons) is clearly legible with sufficient contrast.
The dialog’s existing behavior (cannot dismiss by clicking outside, form submission) remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Strengthen the Product Editor workspace page surface styling so it no longer appears flat white by applying a clearly visible but subtle tinted/gradient background treatment and softened borders/shadows consistent with the existing theme tokens, without changing any generation logic or navigation behavior.

quotes: The refreshed design still appears the same with no visible changes.
Same issue on the Product Editor page
Add a lightly tinted panel background to Product Editor ... so the page no longer looks stark white.
Strengthen border and shadow so the workspace has visible depth.

acceptanceCriteria: The Product Editor workspace area has a visibly tinted/gradient surface (not plain white) in light theme and retains appropriate depth/contrast in dark theme.
Borders and shadows appear softened (no harsh stark outlines), while maintaining clear separation between sections.
All existing Product Editor functionality remains unchanged (editing, tabs, Generate, Generate All Products, error display).

requirements.text: Add a small, non-functional, user-visible styling tweak in the editor view that is always rendered (within the Product Editor workspace container) to serve as a deterministic deployment sanity check, ensuring a fresh deploy clearly reflects the latest styling changes even if caching previously masked updates.

quotes: The refreshed design still appears the same with no visible changes.
Add a lightweight, user-visible sanity check that confirms the deployed build includes the latest styling changes

acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, there is at least one subtle but clearly observable visual change in the editor workspace container styling that can be used to confirm the new build is running.
The tweak does not add new UI features, buttons, or flows; it is purely a styling-level change.
No functional behavior changes occur in the editor view.

requirements.text: Update the onboarding instructions modal header/title copy to match the app’s current neutral branding shown in the header (use English-only text) so the modal no longer references outdated branding.

quotes: the popup window is still transparent and hard to read

acceptanceCriteria: The onboarding modal title does not say “Automation Product Pack!” and instead uses the current app branding consistent with the header title.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
Do not change bundle generation logic, export logic, or view-state navigation behavior as part of these styling fixes.
nonGoals: Adding new features to the onboarding modal beyond styling/copy consistency (e.g., new steps, new tabs, new controls).
Replacing the design system or introducing new UI component libraries.
